In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the continuance of the Echo360 lecture capturing system would be achieved by a balance of IT artefact extension and IS habit development.

the continuance of a new learning system is a complex process, which is influenced by both the system itself (e.g., features) and the user (e.g., habits and perceptions).
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
a learning system is more likely to be continued by students and teachers if it is perceived to be useful and easy to use.
IS artefacts and usage patterns are not independent, but rather, they are intertwined and interact to form the IS habit.
IS artefact extension and IS habit development are two key elements for developing learning system continuance.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the development of learning system continuance requires the joint effort of both IT artefact extension (i.e., system design) and curriculum design (i.e., teaching practice) in the context of higher education.
the design of a lecture capturing technology should be based on a holistic approach that combines the perspectives of both the technology and curriculum.
the design of a learning system should consider not only the needs of students, but also those of teachers and support staff.
